selection: second round after a failed label (picked)

neighbours.label: the word ' because', giving the reason for a fact, as opposed to although, until, and other connectives in the same sentences
fire: We have leap years because the earth's orbit is not exact.
Bread rises because the yeast gives off gas.
It was because she had seen the letter.
They picked the small flat because it faced south.
Oil floats because it is lighter than water.
The match stopped because of the heavy rain.
He quit the team because the coach shouted.
Cats purr because they feel safe.
quiet: We have leap years, and the earth's orbit is not exact.
Bread rises until the yeast stops giving off gas.
It was before she had seen the letter.
They picked the small flat although it faced south.
Oil floats, but it is lighter than water.
The match stopped in spite of the heavy rain.
He quit the team when the coach shouted.

notes: Second round. In a sweep, 'reason clause: because, explanatory when' failed (AUROC 0.891): ' because' 0.59–1.00, while my 'explanatory when' did not separate from time ' when'. One near miss here keeps ' when', and one ' after', both of which reached 0.34–0.39 before.
